WITH user_rank AS (
                SELECT
                    user_id,
                    COUNT(*) AS signed_correct_count,
                    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS position
                FROM
                    gameEvents
                WHERE
                    is_correct = TRUE
                GROUP BY
                    user_id
            )
            SELECT
                user_id,
                CAST(signed_correct_count AS UNSIGNED) AS correct_count,
                CAST(
                    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY signed_correct_count DESC)
                    AS UNSIGNED
                ) AS position
            FROM user_rank
            WHERE user_id = ?
